newsitem.title: USA: PSE to trade Millennium Pharm options from March 4.
newsitem.headline: PSE to trade Millennium Pharm options from March 4.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Thursday it would begin trading options on Millennium Pharmaceuticals Inc on March 4.
Strike prices have been set at 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expirations in March, April, May and August, the exchange said. Position limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
Millennium shares slipped 1/4 to 17 Thursday afternoon.
The PSE said Millennium options have been allocated to lead market makers Guy Leung and Arvin Fong of Omega Options. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
